name: InkRoom Prompts
tagline: Free model and price discovery, image-prompt search and text optimization, without an API key.
description: Read public image-model capabilities and InkRoom sale prices, search prompts with their paired original examples, or explicitly improve an image idea. The free 1.0.4 client provides help, list_models, search_prompts and optimize_prompt. No login, API key or MCP Token; shared service limits apply. Does not generate images or use paid image credits. Requires Node.js 20.3+.

install.notes: Stable 1.0.4; free help/model-price discovery/prompt search/text optimization only. No public Remote MCP endpoint or npm-registry publication is claimed. Never generates images; optimization is optional and subject to shared service limits.
